items.note: The fix adds `useOptionalDepSource` to `@weasel-js/routing`, which publishes a dep and does nothing when no provider is in scope. Core's barrel also exports it.

items.claim: [r42-3] `resolvePreviews` lists a previewed node twice when an unpreviewed container sits between it and a previewed frame
[r42-4] `insertExtrasFromPlane` rewrites a consumer insert kind's extras
items.note: It now maps extras only for the kit's own kinds (`line`, `polygon`, `star` and `pencil`), and only fields that are real points.

Under the identity composition a container carries nothing, and `packages/editing/src/actions/move/move.carried.test.ts` ("writes only the container under the identity strategy, whose containers carry nothing") pins exactly this. Commit b337d8d866 removed the identity branch on purpose. I tried the fix, that test failed, and I reverted it.

items.claim: [r42-6] `actionReferenceSources` answers `'pointer'` in the camera's world and `{ node }` in that node's own plane, while align and flip apply it in another plane
items.note: `actionReferenceSources` takes an optional `plane: { view, layer }`. Align and flip pass the selection's layer, the same choice `selectionLayer` makes.
